passages.title: UTBK Lab: Reading Social-Science Data
passages.text: A town council reported that daily bus trips rose from 1,200 to 1,500 over five years. Officials called the rise evidence that residents were choosing public transport more often. A local researcher checked the town’s population: it had increased from 12,000 to 20,000 over the same period. The number of bus trips per resident had therefore fallen, even though the total number of trips grew. The researcher noted that one bus trip was not necessarily one unique passenger, so further surveys were needed to understand individual travel habits. Both sides agreed that additional data would be valuable.

questions.prompt: What is the best summary of the passage?
choices: Bus trips fell sharply across every year
Population numbers are irrelevant to transport analysis
Bus trips increased, but that alone does not show a higher rate of bus use
Each bus trip always represents a unique passenger
questions.explanation: Perhatikan keseluruhan teks; ringkasan paling tepat harus mencakup topik serta gagasan utamanya.

choices: Perjalanan bus turun tajam setiap tahun
Jumlah penduduk tidak relevan untuk analisis transportasi
Perjalanan bus meningkat, tetapi itu belum membuktikan tingkat penggunaan lebih tinggi
Setiap perjalanan bus selalu satu penumpang unik

questions.evidence: A town council reported that daily bus trips rose from 1,200 to 1,500 over five years.

questions.prompt: How many daily bus trips were recorded after five years?

translationId.prompt: Berapa perjalanan bus harian setelah lima tahun?

questions.prompt: What made the initial official conclusion incomplete?
choices: The town population also grew
The buses stopped working
The council reported no numbers
The researcher counted bicycle rides
questions.explanation: Populasi meningkat sehingga jumlah perjalanan per penduduk justru turun.

translationId.prompt: Apa yang membuat kesimpulan awal pejabat kurang lengkap?
choices: Jumlah penduduk kota juga bertambah
Bus berhenti beroperasi
Dewan tidak melaporkan angka
Peneliti menghitung perjalanan sepeda

questions.evidence: population: it had increased from 12,000 to 20,000

questions.prompt: Why did the researcher recommend more surveys?
choices: To remove all transport data
To understand individual behaviour beyond trip counts
To avoid asking residents anything
To prove every trip was by a new person
questions.explanation: Satu orang dapat melakukan lebih dari satu perjalanan sehingga perlu data perilaku.

choices: Untuk menghapus semua data transportasi
Untuk memahami perilaku individu, tidak hanya hitungan perjalanan
Untuk menghindari bertanya kepada warga
Untuk membuktikan setiap perjalanan dilakukan orang berbeda

questions.evidence: one bus trip was not necessarily one unique passenger
